admission: The original plan specified these seeds before any results. Admission uses verified runtime/data/resume gates, not favorable test scores.
changes_relative_to_seed42: Training/evaluation seed only; freeze data, ID banks, geometry, learning rate, temperature arms and checkpoint-selection policy.
reporting: Report all seeds separately and across-seed mean/SD. Keep within-seed paired-user intervals distinct from training-seed variability.
scope: Released-ID replay and matched ordinary-CE controls, not semantic-only TIGER baselines or a full tokenizer reconstruction.
